manifest.note: QUARANTINE: automatic sentence/fragment candidates, not approved semantic annotations.

hybrid_import.note: Family review does not approve unseen instances; all original contexts are embedded.

manifest.note: Exact earlier extraction outputs preserved after rollback. Row review_status values are historical claims; this import does not grant admission. Automatic candidates include known parser errors. Existing registered inventories remain unchanged.

entities.jsonl.gz.scope: Typed readings, including complete names and common noun phrases. Admission uses the entity pool below; this metadata never enables generation from pending ranges or retypes source occurrences. Original wording is preserved, including understood nonstandard wording.

source_context.address_format: split:dialogue:turn (one-based); the complete dialogue includes preceding, following and confirming turns.

entities.jsonl.gz.reading_reference: readings select complete rows in entity_pool by the listed fields; existing_readings refer to the original candidate surface in the Built-in pool. Determiners and explicit heads in generation phrases do not rewrite source text. adapter_only records refer to exact shared catalog patterns; their context_entity_readings are not freely sampled slot fillers.

default_reasons.admitted: The reviewed context supports this named reading; other senses of the same string are not retyped.
default_reasons.already_available: Same named surface/type reading already exists; retain its more specific type and realization metadata. This is not approval of every source mention.

decisions.reason: The dialogue explicitly calls Alabama a website. Retain that surface as a website reading, not a geographic place; do not guess Alibaba or assert that the named site exists outside the dialogue. Free slot substitution is withheld: The source spelling is preserved, not silently corrected to Alibaba. A website reading does not license arbitrary give/say frames.
decisions.previous_reason: Alabama is presented as a website; these occurrences do not support a geographic filler.
